mapper.select: SELECT feature_code, feature_name, phase, scope, granularity, action_type, risk_level, enabled_in_program, sort_order FROM feature_catalog ORDER BY sort_order, feature_code

SELECT override_record.id, override_record.subscription_id, override_record.feature_code, override_record.override_type, override_record.effective_from, override_record.effective_until, override_record.change_reason, override_record.created_by, override_record.created_at, feature.feature_name FROM subscription_feature_override override_record JOIN feature_catalog feature ON feature.feature_code = override_record.feature_code ORDER BY override_record.created_at DESC, override_record.id DESC
SELECT quota_code, quota_name, unit_name, enabled_in_program, sort_order FROM quota_catalog ORDER BY sort_order, quota_code

SELECT override_record.id, override_record.subscription_id, override_record.quota_code, override_record.quota_value, override_record.effective_from, override_record.effective_until, override_record.change_reason, override_record.created_by, override_record.created_at, quota.quota_name, quota.unit_name FROM subscription_quota_override override_record JOIN quota_catalog quota ON quota.quota_code = override_record.quota_code ORDER BY override_record.created_at DESC, override_record.id DESC
SELECT id, operation_type, operator_user_id, target_type, target_id, change_reason, before_json, after_json, success, error_code, created_at FROM platform_audit_log ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

WITH ranked_override AS ( SELECT override_record.feature_code, override_record.override_type, override_record.created_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY override_record.subscription_id, override_record.feature_code ORDER BY override_record.created_at DESC, override_record.id DESC ) AS row_number FROM subscription_feature_override override_record WHERE override_record.subscription_id = #{subscriptionId} AND override_record.effective_from <= #{now} AND (override_record.effective_until IS NULL OR override_record.effective_until > #{now}) ) SELECT feature.feature_code, feature.feature_name, feature.phase, feature.scope, feature.granularity, feature.action_type, feature.risk_level, feature.enabled_in_program, feature.sort_order, CASE WHEN plan_feature.feature_code IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS plan_enabled, active_override.override_type, active_override.created_at AS override_created_at FROM feature_catalog feature LEFT JOIN plan_revision_feature plan_feature ON plan_feature.plan_revision_id = #{planRevisionId} AND plan_feature.feature_code = feature.feature_code LEFT JOIN ranked_override active_override ON active_override.feature_code = feature.feature_code AND active_override.row_number = 1 WHERE (#{includeFuture} = TRUE OR feature.enabled_in_program = 1) AND (#{featureCode} IS NULL OR feature.feature_code = #{featureCode}) ORDER BY feature.sort_order, feature.feature_code

SELECT feature.feature_code, feature.enabled_in_program, CASE WHEN plan_feature.feature_code IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS plan_enabled FROM feature_catalog feature LEFT JOIN plan_revision_feature plan_feature ON plan_feature.plan_revision_id = #{planRevisionId} AND plan_feature.feature_code = feature.feature_code WHERE feature.feature_code = #{featureCode} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO subscription_feature_override (subscription_id, feature_code, override_type, effective_from, effective_until, change_reason, created_by) VALUES (#{subscriptionId}, #{featureCode}, #{overrideType}, #{effectiveFrom}, #{effectiveUntil}, #{reason}, #{operatorId})

INSERT INTO subscription_quota_override (subscription_id, quota_code, quota_value, effective_from, effective_until, change_reason, created_by) VALUES (#{subscriptionId}, #{quotaCode}, #{quotaValue}, #{effectiveFrom}, #{effectiveUntil}, #{reason}, #{operatorId})
